subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Fiddle Game
description: A quick, practical guide to The Fiddle Game.

hook.text: A man leaves a cheap violin at a restaurant. Another man arrives and says it's worth a fortune.

buildup.text: The second man, a shill, offers the restaurant owner thousands to buy the violin.

discovery.text: The first man returns. The owner buys the violin cheaply, thinking they can resell it for thousands.

twist.text: Both men are partners. The violin is worth nothing. The owner paid for a worthless instrument.

climax.text: The fiddle game works by creating artificial demand — making something worthless seem priceless.

punchline.text: Perceived value is just another con artist's tool.

quiz.question: How does the fiddle game create value from nothing?
options: A shill pretends the worthless item is extremely valuable
